titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦庄襄王三年: introductions

div.p: The Basic Annals of Qin for the third and last year of King Zhuangxiang: Meng Ao's campaigns in Wei and Zhao, the founding of Taiyuan Commandery, the five-state army under Lord Xinling that drove Qin back to Hewai, and the king's death in May and the accession of his son Zheng.
The row of the Table of the Six States for this year: the entries for Qin, Wei and Han.
